risks.title: Repository hygiene drift enters Goal Tracking commits
risks.mitigation: Stage only scoped Goal Tracking files and keep tracked deletion decisions in a dedicated repository hygiene PR.
risks.next_action: Prepare repository hygiene review before staging deletion changes.

risks.title: Progress overclaim from planned review records
risks.mitigation: Keep cadence and cycle records planned or active until dated review evidence proves a performed review.
risks.next_action: Record performed daily, weekly, or monthly reviews only with current-period evidence.

risks.title: Generated Goal Tracking Center becomes stale
risks.mitigation: Run the generator and freshness check after any source-record update.
risks.next_action: Keep `npm run check:goal-command-center-view` in the scoped validation set.
